entities.summary: Quinton Byfield is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a forward for the Los Angeles Kings of the National Hockey League (NHL). Byfield was selected second overall by the Kings in the 2020 NHL entry draft, the highest-drafted black player in NHL history. He made his NHL debut with the Kings in 2021.
